title: totem amogus meme
description: A funny Amogus-themed totem meme pack for Minecraft
body:
This project adds a funny Amogus‑themed totem meme to Minecraft that plays a loud, hilarious sound when it saves you from death. It is made for players who want to turn the usually serious totem moment into a chaotic joke and create meme‑worthy clips with friends. The pack keeps the rest of the game mostly vanilla, so you can safely use it in survival worlds, on servers, or together with other resource packs and mods. :3
